import rates
from donations import load_donations, ROWS
from fees import DonationBill

FULL = sum(v * rates._RATES[k] for k, v in ROWS)


def test_charge_after_add():
    rows = list(load_donations())
    bill = DonationBill()
    bill.add(rows[0])
    first = bill.charge()
    bill.add(rows[1])
    assert bill.charge() == first + ROWS[1][1] * rates._RATES[ROWS[1][0]]


def test_charge_after_every_add():
    bill = DonationBill()
    running = 0
    for x in load_donations():
        bill.add(x)
        running += x.pounds * rates._RATES[x.donor]
        assert bill.charge() == running


def test_no_new_lookups_when_unchanged():
    bill = DonationBill()
    for x in load_donations():
        bill.add(x)
    assert bill.charge() == FULL
    before = rates.LOOKUPS
    bill.charge()
    bill.charge()
    assert rates.LOOKUPS == before


def test_empty_bill():
    assert DonationBill().charge() == 0
